name: Santiago Reos
tagline: guitarra y palmas · one half of Dúo Dø デュオ・ドー · Buenos Aires → Japan
bio: Guitarist, composer, producer and educator from Buenos Aires — one half of Dúo Dø (est. 2015), the genre-free, in-motion project weaving Argentine roots with Japan. Led the SongCamp Challenge Latam EP presented on The Creator Economy stage during Devconnect Argentina; artist-in-residence at Kismet Casa during FarCon Rome 2026 (the film 'Mi Amor Por Ti' — Shaka among its Executive Producers); shown with the Infinite Garden Artist Cohort. Japan Tour 2026: Sep 19 – Dec 15.
quote: Dúo Dø nace de la necesidad de comunicarme mejor: armonías que dibujan imágenes y transmiten mis emociones.
numbers_note: chair numbers 010/011 assigned by the order duodomusica.com presents the duo (Santiago first) — numbers per Shaka; swap on your word
songs_note: Releases per duodomusica.com: Yama (ft. Dig.Dug, 2026), Piano Works 1 (EP, 2025), Nostalgia (2025); plus Todo Cambia ft. Hiroe Morikawa and Torii on Bandcamp. Nothing appears on this node without the artists' blessing, item by item.
